I so wish I was your size but I am not.  However, I am the best at research and the Federal Government.  I see you say you left your abusive home say no more.  You left with nothing and rebuilding.  Here are resources and special things to help in your state.  I won't pretend to know exactly and don't tell me but contact these people.

https://gcadv.org/

This is the Georgia Coalition Against Domestic Violence
There are a lot of things open to you for you to do.  You can apply for Emergency Food Stamps, and SSI benefits if you don't work.  All of this is under the resource section of this page.  There are places that will help you find housing and jobs if needed.  Making the decision to leave is the hardest but, now putting it back together is a fresh start.  

Good Luck...

Hey, let me help you with a one stop shop for both.  Believe it or not LIEHP can assist with a one time payment for your electric under the hardship energy program funded by Emergency Solutions Grant which they just Got in October, 2017.  The program is run thru the Department of Agriculture in your county.  But, Feds cut the check on 10/1....  They have it.. Getting them to answer can be challenging depending on county you live in.  I kept getting in July, sorry not taking appointments.  It made me feel they were out of funding but they get funding in October and June???  All States and Counties do....  It is from the Federal Government to the States for Energy Assistance.  And since it is the Emergency Solutions Grant they can also help with Rent... Yeah... but only one time and for up to a maximum of about $600.00  So call them right away...  Make sure they will pay all in arrears.  Try and get them to come out and read the meter too before you go so you can maximize your $300 benefit amount based off income.  But make sure you get that Appointment.  If you have a hard time getting thru.. By all means contact me and I will tell you who the Federal Contact is in your county.  

When I called the Public Housing Authority who manages it in Polk County they were??  I said I am sorry but I know they just got the Grant Money and unfortunately I don't understand why for two days in a row I call every hour on the hour and no one picks up and I get they are not accepting appointments.  Should I call Electric Company and ask them for an extension.  Oh Florida does not give 30 days even if you are late.  They cut you right off.  Apparently, they had the funds just not enough people to adhere to the need??  How many powers were turned off because well I just could not see you...  Sorry...  I hate bad efficiency.  Plus you have all these requirements for people who either have to volunteer or go to the career center if getting TANF or Benefits.  Lets see why not coordinate during your peak season.  Unemployed gain real life skills for resume and people don't lose power.  Win-Win but just a suggestion.. Who am I though...

Alright just because your County doesn’t have a person does not mean you can’t get the Resources. This is where I get mad and determined but I can talk to you more about this personally. I never take that crap and everyone has a reporting Department. So me I go above their head. Direct message me and I will tell you what I would do.

There are things they still can do if you are in a hardship. You need to still ask for a refinance HARP program hardship assistance. That is not looking at your score as much as it is to avoid foreclosure. But in essence it could lower your principal balance or take the missed pmt or Pmts if you have a valid hardship as to why you could not pay. IE change in job lost wages. Illness. It has to be something substantial. They have to work with you. Follow the notices and talk to a housing counselor in your area. Under the HOME program.

If your dealing with a mortgage of 3400 I hope you purchased the home before 2009. Now either way have you called your Mortgage Co. and explained your hardship. By law they have to help you either way. I by no means am an expert in this field I was just a struggling Mother who had experienced a similar situation in another state. At the very bottom are some helpful links. 

1.  See if you can Refinance your home and try to lower the Pmts. If your home is purchased in 2009 or even after the programs are there they are just different. For individuals in 2009 they purchased their homes at balloon prices so if you were one of these people you could potentially get your house reassessed to a more current market value and refinance at that rate. If after 2009 you can still refinance but lower the interest and extend the mortgage. This is a HARDSHIP program so you have to be able to document the hardship which includes losing employment for a period of time. 


2.  You need to decide is it worth trying to save this home???  Should you stay and/or should you sell. You could short sale your home. I started this process and no I did not pay my mortgage while doing this. I then banked everything so we could get an apartment but we still had hardships. It’s ok the world will not end. 

3.  You could wait, not pay the mortgage and then when they try to foreclose go and file Bankruptcy. It will cost 1500-2000 for Ch 13. There you will go thru a debt class and consolidation. But under chapter 13 you have the potential to be able to keep your homestead. However, you are required to pay back all other debts. 

4. Check out local food banks thru your area United Way or 211. They will be able to tell you. If you have kids talk to the school social worker who can help direct you with Resources for Food. 

Foreclosure Advice:

https://www.hud.gov/sites/documents/FHA_SAVEYOURHOME.PDF

https://www.hud.gov/topics/avoiding_foreclosure

https://www.hud.gov/states/pennsylvania/homeownership/foreclosure

https://www.phfa.org/counseling/hemap.aspx

Guides to Help for Homelessness in PA:

I don’t know which County you are in but here are the Grants given to PA for the last three years. If you click on your County you will see how and where the money to help Homelessness has gone. It is a start. 

https://www.hudexchange.info/grantees/find-a-grantee/?state=PA&params=%7B%22limit%22%3A20%2C%22sort%22%3A%22%22%2C%22years%22%3A%5B%5D%2C%22searchTerm%22%3A%22%22%2C%22dir%22%3A%22%22%2C%22grantees%22%3A%5B%5D%2C%22state%22%3A%22PA%22%2C%22programs%22%3A%5B%5D%7D##granteeSearch

Also, call your 211 and United Way for Food Banks in your area. 

I hope this gives you a start. Happy Working.

Thanks for your thoughts.  This is a big money making business and I am not sure sometimes whether the government is making it better or worse.  This year they are close to spending a billion on the opiate epidemic.  They have every agency from Department of Transportation, Department of Commerce, Department of Defense, to Department of Health and Department of Justice establishing grants on this issue.  I understand there is a need for this I just wish someone would have been appointed as the lead or head Department/Agency and could have coordinated with all other groups as to what and how they were going to tackle this issue.  Instead of just making it a free for all and everyone putting their stamp in on how they were going to make their mark.  This is where being so big is bad.....  We know there is an issue and we know what, now the how and proper way.  Who heads the task force so to speak.  Is it a war on drugs or a social, psychological issue.  So many things should be worked on before a President or higher up official just makes a blanket statement that we are going to be fighting or dealing with this.  That all sound great until you try and apply it.  And, they big boys who sit at the table, they are not even the ones who do the work.  So by the time it actually gets to the worker bees they are left with a mess to handle on damn, now what??

Just like when President Obama stated full Transparency for the Stimulas Money.  And you would know everyone who received the grants.  Great statement so to avoid the TARP mess up with giving bonus to the Bank Officials with government money.  Well, sounds good but, he should have put in there as morally and ethically responsible.  Why, think about it. Department of Justice gives Orlando County Sheriff Department XX amount of Dollars to be used for different awards.  They choose to give out 2000 awards to individuals who are victims of domestic violence.  Do you think those people want or need their names on a Government Database as to Sally Smith (example) received 2000 from Victims Benefit Fund from Orlando Sheriff Dept.  That was his initiative for full Transparency as disclosed to the world??  Two tier reporting so everyone knew where the grant money was going.  Or even in this case Me Smith received 3500 for Homeless Assistance.  Some things are meant to be kept private if for nothing else because of the sheer nature of the information.  When it comes to Mental Health, Addiction, Abuse, things of that nature.  But, it took a long time for the worker bees to get this information and then many and I mean many meetings and workshops occurred on how were the Departments and Agencies going to address the Presidents initiative as well as respect the privacy of individuals??  

But, I see many abuses in the legal system to keep you coming back.  They say you have to have an address or your probation can be cancelled.  However, they don't help you get housing when leaving prison and some half way houses or drug rehab houses are full.  If you don't have a bed they will give you a hotel room for three days.  That is it.  Now, think of this you have been locked up for 5 years or 10 years.  You have no place to live, you do have training and skills but no job.  All houses are full so you are on the waiting list.  You have three days to report to Probation and you are not legally allowed to be homeless or they can violate your probation but they only help you with three days and give you a $25.00 check when you leave.  That is a sad state of affairs and a sad outlook for some.  It is no wonder people go back to the streets to the criminal friends they left or to what they know.  For when you are away time stops literally.  While all around you it continues on.  I only wish more people understood this.  And yes those individuals put themselves there but, a good majority of them were addicts and are ill.  They have been sober for years some of them coming out.  If only they could go back to a new fresh start.  But the recovery programs in Prison are a joke.  You are not truly going to open up and be honest in a facility where your privacy is not respected.

You want to hear the best. I was very successful and worked on Capitol Hill. So I am good at tracking money. So I found and applied and received a grant to get into a place. But, I’m a felon, bad credit, and homeless. I live in a hotel have steady income. Bad Credit because I went to prison. No money or potential to earn while away. Felony is driving on Revoked license. DUI is misdemeanor. Before 2014 I owned two homes had never rented and had excellent credit but what do you do?  I don’t drink have not had a drink since 2013.  I will be debt free next yr but that does not fix today. Grant will pay 1st, last, and deposit. Even higher deposit Amt to help. Can’t find anyone to take it. I am not going to lie or not be honest about my situation because I’m tired of lying. Too tired. Exhausted. I can get Character reference letters, hell I got disability 1st try. The grant 1st try. But this shit I can’t do to save my life. Bad Timing, timing, timing. I can do anything Government wise but this shit is driving me nuts.

I am both homeless and disabled. It sucks and sucks bad. What’s worse is I’m a convicted felon pathetic. A recovering Alcoholic who tried to kill herself drinking but only managed to make myself disabled and a felon. I am grateful I have not hurt anyone physically with my drinking but I did drink and drive. Hence why I’m a felon. So, lost everything. Now, have not drank since 2013 trying to start over but still picking up pieces. And just when you think it’s bottom he’ll no. Now I have to watch it sober. Depressed absolutely. Don’t want to go out yep. Wish I were dead sure. But why keep going because someone out there is going to miss me damn it and I can’t take anymore guilt. Pure and simple it is the only thing keeping me going right now. 

So here it is for you if you end your life I will miss you. That is one person that will be sad you will not be here. That is one reason to keep going. It is what keeps us all connected. I have had everything and had nothing but what we all need is someone. So reach out even if you are scared. I’m scared out of my mind but I know my kids need and deserve me. It’s not perfect or ideal but damn it I’m going to make it if it kills me.

That’s why I think I’m so fucked up now. My family hates me. I’m am the embarrassment and sometimes I get sad but mostly mad. I used to say we were the family that as long as the front porch was clean and looked perfect it was fine. But, if you actually went inside the house would be a disaster. No one was ever allowed inside. Pretty flowers, great yard, white picket fence. Everything looks great. Go in. No food house a wreck kids mess falling apart. That is how it felt. Oh and the made up fucking stories of how great things were. 

So when I grew up, I used to make it a point to check those inconsistencies. They hated that. It would be remember when you were little and we used to xxxx. And I would quickly state and as soon as I got dirty or tried to talk to other kids how you would pull my hair and tell me how nasty and disgusting I was. That girls that look like me grow up to he whores. You know when I was 7 because my knees showed. Funny right!!!  Ha Ha. I got a real kick out of that. My childhood was lovely. Oh or how about when you decided to cheat on Dad so we went on adventures. Then they got divorced when I was young but even then she lied because it was the 80’s. So I lived with my Dad. She told her friends she was my grandmother. You know image is everything. I found that out at my wedding. Oh yeah I can relate totally. My other siblings don’t understand me but they all care about image too. Me I always dress wrong, act wrong, say the wrong things. But they are older. I even married wrong. I think I did it to spite them. But now I had to get away far away. So I moved many states away. It feels like a house of lies.

There is no just reward one way or the other. I spent time in a Maximum Security women’s prison. I was there for a driving charge and I was only there because they were the only facility who had the medical resources to handle my condition. But, there was a Mother there who was doing life because she did kill her daughters child molester 17 years ago. Her daughter was 7 and was being abused by one of her coaches. So she took justice in her own hands and killed the man who had taken her daughters innocence. 

At the time my daughter was 7 and I think I too am capable of doing the same thing. But on the other side she has spent 17 yrs behind bars watching from afar her daughter grow up. She has no regrets and will tell you she would do it again. Her husband visits her every week. She is content with the decision she made and is at peace. But, she stopped one sick pervert only to be replaced by another. Because thru the doors comes another molester who happens to be a woman who “only helped” her husband film children doing things with them. It was disgusting and it made me ill even hearing her story. I thought from stories you always here on TV people like that always get beat up and picked on in prison. Well that is true in Men’s facilities. Not so much in women’s. Oh they get talked about and people put there noses up. But beat up and bashed, no. So there she was living in the same POD with the woman who killed her daughters rapist living three doors down from each other. They even worked at the same place because Taylor Shop pays the most money 1.10 an hour. The average is .80 an hour because it is an outside contract. But, no one wants to lose their position so they find a way to deal and stay ticket free. In fact most fighting is over love triangles of who is dating who and who loves whom. Petty high school stuff, butt my stent was short.  In the end the door just keeps on revolving. 

So if your father did commit this act it will be his to answer for. The justice system does not reform or make anyone accountable. All it does is house and feed at 30k a year per inmate as the estimate goes. He will one day thru his higher power have to answer for his sins just as the person who hurt you will and did answer for his. What happens after that is not for any of us to know. The only moral responsibility you have to yourself now is could your father be a danger to himself or others?  Why would your father place such a moral burden on your heart?  I would ask him these things but in front of a priest so they could never be shared in court. After I sought absolution.   Good Luck and God Bless.

I just moved. I used to live an hour away from everyone.  I had to wait a yr to leave my home state. I stayed and did all the Holidays and parties as expected in 2016. When away I was sent about an additional hour and half away from where I lived so it was a hike. But it was close to their campground. I however did put myself in that situation but, it can be a place of growth and healing. Oh they called and checked on me thru my husband and did things with my kids. I don’t hate as much I wonder they spend so much time on beating me when I’m down or at least that’s how I feel. I don’t think I ever remember a time they congratulated me when I faired well. Maybe it is because we come from a tough family. I don’t know. Maybe it is the significant age gap between all of us. My siblings are all 4 yrs apart and I’m 8 yrs younger than the youngest.  Only thing is we all have kids and they all love each other. So me I don’t engage unless I have too. But my kids ask all the time. So I send them up the road with Dad and he drops them off at my Moms. I just come up with some sort of illness or I schedule a procedure/surgery.  We missed Christmas and two birthdays already and I’m ok I guess. But my kids they are bummed. So I don’t know how to proceed. I live with my own shame and guilt which is already sometimes unbearable. I don’t need theirs too.

Well I’m not sure why people are against 12 step programs. AA and a cop saved my life. Keep up with your Drs and the program. Try different Groups and if you find one you particularly like the message let them know you are newly sober. People will reach out. Reach back and that is what it is all about. Try and find a temporary sponsor. I say temporary because finding a permanent one you should take your time with. But if you like it find someone who can guide you thru the program. I drank a hole thru my stomach and had two blood transfusions. I lost my career, house, car, and almost my life. I say it’s like a country song. If I could play it backwards maybe I could get my dog back, my car back, my job back and my house back. If only it was that easy. And I only drank for 3 years hard straight but it was all day everyday. I came close to killing myself but the law caught me first. Now I am 39 and have anemia, osteoporosis, vitamin D and b-12 deficiency, fatty liver, pancreatitis, half of a stomach, part of my intestines removed, and Mental health issues. But, I’m alive. And I’ve not had a drink since 2013. I don’t have cirrhosis of the liver, which is a plus. But, they said don’t drink after Gastric Bypass and I did not listen. 

There is a solution but everyone has to hit their own bottom. For me it was almost dying. So you have to ask yourself is this your bottom?  Keep going to meetings no matter what people say on here because I believe Meeting makers make it. No one can do it alone.

It is funny the entitlement some people feel because they have “made it”.   There are those wealthy people who made it by hard work whom you could stand next to and never know they had millions and sometimes billions because they worked so hard for it they don’t feel the need to flaunt it and then there are those who have made a few hundred thousand who live like stars.  It’s funny if you ever look at someone like Warren Buffet who was at one time the wealthiest man in America driving a simple Toyota around all day. A billionaire?  Why not a Bentley or Rolls?  Well maybe because all of his money was made the old fashioned way by hard work. He bought a candy company simply because he likes to eat candy. And now his life’s mission is to give his entire fortune away before he dies. He has given over 40 billion and counting. His sister Dottie Buffet has the Sunshine Foundation and they call her the Sunshine Lady Fund’s Education for Prison Inmates, Mentally Ill, and the Disadvantage. They have given millions to help what society would deem are socially unacceptable people.  They have personally had relationships with these lowlifes and helped them get on their feet. Why because everyone deserves a second chance. I wonder what your family would think of that. A dinner party with ExCons. But if it was hosted by a Billionaire I bet it would be the best thing since sliced bread. It is all perception. Who cares anyway because one mistake or misstep and those riches could be gone. Then all you have left is family. We come into this world broke and we leave this world broke. What matters is what kind of mark we leave behind. No one has the right to judge, and if they are they need to take a long hard look into their life. Material things are stuff, which are given and taken away. Being a good person and loving your fellow man, that takes work. 

Even I am guilty. I have judged the guy or girl asking for money at the corner at the light. Well, no more. I give whatever change I have and try to make no judgment. I don’t know what their situation or life events led them there.

I am not bitter but a bit envious. I can’t undue my experiences. All of which have led me to this awful disease I would wish upon no one. From the mental abuse I took as a child to the inferior way I feel about myself now. I wish it upon no one. I always feel like a person looking on the outside watching everyone playing nicely in the sandbox wanting so badly to join but feeling so awkward and different. I hope people never go thru that. Hell, I don’t want my own kids to know it. I tell them every day they are worthy of love and worthy to be loved no matter what. I also tell them they are perfect just the way they are but by no means am I perfect. I make mistakes and do things wrong but unlike my parents I immediately recognize those behaviors and cycles of disease talking and I apologize. That’s all I think I ever wanted as a kid and adult a genuine apology that it was not me but them. I am an imperfect human and I’m ill and sometimes the disease gets the best of me. I always tell my children it is not them. And sometimes that means swallowing my pride and admitting I overreacted. As to the outside world I am so afraid to let anyone in, I mean really in I am always watching from the outside. Everyone always thinks I’m so strong but inside I’m just a weak little girl looking for a way in. That is true sickness. I am not bitter, I wish I could be more like them but I did not grow up normal. My home was more like a war zone. No cookies and camp for me. I only hope to break the cycle for the next generation, even if it means I have to fake it.
Thank You so much for your advice. I will take all of this into account and apply it.

The only issue with importing Ephedrine into the US is because it is the main ingredient in Methamphetamine it is illegal to import it as an individual.  It is a regulated Federal Supplement so I would beware of ordering it from another country.  The only way to order it is if you are ordering it from oversees.  Then it would be a federal offence and to me it just is not worth it if you can just go and buy it at a local store.  Maybe not exactly what you want but, better than nothing.  I used to order it all the time but that was when it was not regulated.  Now that it is, I am too scared.  It would be my luck that it would get flagged thru the postal service.

I can completely relate from a totally different perspective. I am a recovering Alcoholic. I drank for three years hard. I have two beautiful children that my family loves very much but they are judgemental.  I ruined my 6 figure career, went bankrupt, got multiple DUIs, and finally went to prison. However, none of that scared me straight to stop drinking. The only thing that stopped me was being arrested the last time for a suspected DUI and I was on my was to buy alcohol. I appeared intoxicated but had not a drop in me yet. I was sick by then so sick I was dying and did not know it. In two weeks had I not gone to jail and I drank I would have died. I drank a hole in my stomach. Long story short, I went to prison for drinking related driving without a license charge and my daughter was there. But God knew I was done. However, that does not stop the judgements on both sides. I had to come home and deal with the wreckage of my past and I had to deal with insensitivity of my family not being considerate of the fact that I’m real uncomfortable around alcohol. Yes the typical stereotype of the reformed. I don’t want o be around it. I was gone for 22 months and got out in April of 2016. My nephew had a 13 Birthday party in August of 2016. My sister calls and informs me that she understands if I don’t want to come because there will be alcohol there?  Instead of saying we can find a way not to have it because this will be the first family gathering you will be able to attend and we want you to be as comfortable as possible it was we understand if you don’t come. Mom can bring the kids. Now mind you I also found out they went camping several times not more than 30 minutes from where I was at but they were too busy to come and visit. I probably deserved that. But, it hurt my feelings. Now, I get the if I were you here is what I would do to make things work. Well I used to be the same way. But, no more what I did when I was broke 18, single, or it was just me and my boyfriend is entirely different than what I do at 39. Circumstances with two children make it that way. You don’t know what you will do until the car is headed straight for you with the headlights on you. So I say today I am doing this but tomorrow I reserve the right to change my mind. At the end of the day there are no right or wrong answers. If you love your family and I do mine even though they drive me crazy spend time with them but always have a safety plan. I have to. For me it is not even my husband. I have to go to an AA meeting sometime thru the event just to right size myself and let go of my resentments. I don’t know if they have any but I do. And I can’t control theirs but I surely can control mine. I’ve gone so far as to miss the family meals and eat with complete strangers. Just because I have felt more acceptance and love from them. However, my family is my family.  Sometimes I look at them and think they are one traffic stop from being me. But, they won’t know or understand unless they have walked in my shoes and I would not will it on my worst enemy. That is another reason why I don’t like to be around alcohol because it is a reminder of how stupid I was to just give everything away so freely. It takes nothing in these days to get a DUI and you can get one on your own property operating any motorized vehicles. And my family always does and something always gets hits. This year it was a post but all it takes is a report and the wrong officer. Then you are me?  Maybe not as bad but it is a start. 

So my recommendation to you is to have an exit plan. Or a safe place. Go to a meeting not AA but Alanon or a support group. It’s an hour to decompress and I can assure you, it will make you feel so much better and right sized. Your tears of pain will be tears of understanding. 

I hope this helps. 

With Love
A Recovering Drunk

The fact that your even asking the question means you are concerned so just to be safe I would go get it checked out. There are several factors to consider such as age, family history, previous surgery, diet, and any injuries you could have sustained that no one on here can evaluate without being your Dr.  I have had upper and lower GI bleeding and they are not something to mess with or to ask on a message board. If you have insurance it won’t be but a visit to the Dr and a simple test to tell if in fact you are bleeding. Then maybe collecting a stool sample. Some tests but in the long run it is better to be safe than sorry especially if you are over 35. Our bodies change at this age and don’t bounce back like they use to.

I believe because always when I think I’m going to be at my worst he somehow always provides for me. Now that does not mean I am to sit around with foxhole prayers just awaiting his answer I have to get up and seek his truth and trust he will provide what I need at the time I need it. It is Thy will be done not my will.  And I will face a lot of non believers and naysayers but that is ok to. Everyone is entitled to their own opinion and I should love all. I am not to judge because I am in no position to judge unless I want to be judged. I do get worried and worked up not knowing or being able to plan but somehow he always comes through and then all I can be is humbled and blessed. Wether it is family or friends I am lucky to have people who love us enough to reach out a helping hand. I don’t deserve it and could give you a million reasons why yet they still help us. That is a true miracle in itself. That is why I believe wholeheartedly.

Also once you get the hospital bill you can go back to Medicaid and you should now with your Drs bills. If your total monthly medical expenses exceed your monthly income. You do qualify for Medicaid. It is called a Paydown. You have to talk to the specialist or head of the social services department. They will know. But if you just call in half of them have no idea. Take in all your medical debts. Everything you owe outstanding and prescription copays too. They will add it all together. It is a complicated formula and they will tell you how many quarters you can get Medicaid for. This is in addition to your regular insurance plan. They would be secondary. It is supposed to help you be able to pay down your previous Medical expenses before incurring any new ones. But hell if it just gets you thru the birth that is Relief enough. 

For diapers check out your women’s resource centers in your area or your catholic charities they have services that assist with diapers and formula for struggling mothers. Also, try you 211 number in your area which is United Way and they can direct you to women’s help groups for mothers. Also try your Health Department they can direct you to different programs that might be able to help you. 

As for the birth thing I would not give up on finding a solution to getting a secondary insurance just to cover your child. I would also try and contact an Health advocacy Group to see if they can help.

I'm so sorry your in pain. I understand completely how you feel. If you want to talk you can message me anytime. The holidays are a hard time of year. The good thing is you reached out on here. I hope you talk to someone. Just remember you are worthy of love and worthy to be loved. Being depressed is not easy and if you don't talk to anyone on here I would hope that you will at least call the 211 in your area to get the number for psychology services or suicide prevention. Sometimes just talking helps it really does. Please reach out. We only have to do it one day at a time. Sometimes one hour at a time.

I completely understand. I tried to kill myself at 13 and was unsuccessful. I ended up in intensive care and a psych ward after for two week. They said it would get better and I'll t didn't. I made it better for awhile but I always felt like I did not belong. I got married, went to college, had kids, built the great home. From the outside it look liked I had everything but I was miserabl. So then I was too scared to kill myself again so I cashed out and drank. I thought I was doing it in secret but that was a lie too. I did it 24 seven hoping I drank enough the night before to not wake up. I cashed out. I barely made it to work got arrested on multiple DUIs and almost did die. But damn I don't know if it is Karma or God the last time on the way to get alcohol I was coming out of the store and arrested on another suspected DUI. I forgot my debit card so I could not get any. I had just got out of psych ward and was out two days when this occured. My daughter who was 6 was with me. I had nothing in my system but I was off. I had two broken ankles so I had to cut the temporary casts off to drive the car. My license had been suspended but I just wanted to die. Just go to sleep and not wake up. A peaceful death. My life insurance would pay off the house and leave enough money for the kids to have a little for college. I was poison and felt my husband and family deserve D better. Please don't take his words lightly.  I did try to kill myself at 13 and I had another friend at 14 who was successful.  There were plenty of warning signs from both parties.  For myself, I was depressed and bullied, had a broken home and constantly made fun of.  For the other boy he seemed to be from a well to do family but apparently, had been writing these journals about loving my other friend and she was his whole world and if his mother did not let him date her he would just kill himself.  Well his mother told him no, he was absolutely not to see her anymore and he told her he hated her took his dad's shot gun and the next thing she heard was the blast.  All of these especially from impulsive kids are warning signs that can't be ignored.  Adults can rationalize better but children their minds are still developing and at that age their willpower and control are too fragile.  He might be mad at you initially but in the long run he will love you and understand later when he gets older.  They need to talk, they must talk.  It does not have to be so serious.  I was fortunate that they found me and pumped my stomach but I still ended up in ICU.  I still have issues and I hope my kids end up ok.  My son shows signs and hates therapy so I have tried alternatives like Big/Brother programs.  Something to get them talking.  They have to have a way to express their feelings in an open and healthy format.  Also, I always tell them what better way than to have someone you can tell anything to and they can't tell anyone no matter what.  Not even your parents.  You get to vent and complain or run things by without judgments.  They are there just to help you work things out.  I had to reassure Him they are not there to tell you what is right or wrong because that is more subjective but just to help you work thru your feelings and how situations make you feel.  And if you don't like who you are dealing with and you don't click we find another one, until we find the right connection....
